notes.title: Version 1.8.5 is out!
notes.content:
Hello commanders,

Your command interface has just received a bug-fixing update, here's the list:

Version 1.8.5

Fixes:
Squashed a long-standing nasty bug that would prevent players from playing cards in multiplayer games
Fixed an issue preventing players to shoot a Centipede again before combat after it ressurected

We hope you enjoy this update to your command software, and happy Xenosathem mining!

notes.title: Version 1.8.4 is out!
notes.content:
Hello commanders,

Your command interface has just received a few of updates with improvements and fixes, here are the full notes:

Version 1.8.2

Improvements
Installation and download sizes for the game should be much smaller now, thanks to some nifty optimizations
Game now waits for players to be ready after a Fight step resolves
Wrap-up phase will no longer be auto-skipped if you have any troops in lane(s)
Feedback button will now lead to CMON's website on desktop platforms
Under the hood rules engine improvements

And More:
UI will no longer briefly show the "ERROR" dialog when quitting a finished game
Grave Titan Tarantula ability and its ilk will now properly highlight the burned cards on clients
Fixed an issue with Division cards ending up in the wrong place during Solo Play
Fixed an issue with some Hive buffs being removed before they should

Version 1.8.3

Fixes:
Card abilities will now properly refresh in clients

Version 1.8.4

Fixes:
Fixed a lock-up that would occur on certain abilities triggered on death
Fixed a graphical issue with card frames on older devices
Fixed an issue with the tutorial

Thank you all for playing, and stay tuned for Dreadmire!

notes.title: Version 1.8.1 is out!
notes.content:
Hello commanders,

Your command interface has just received a couple of updates with improvements and fixes, here are the full notes:

Version 1.8

NorTec Elite Review
Many cards from the NorTec Elite expansion have been reviewed to match their final published versions.

And More:
Options screen has been standardized; It looks the same both in and out of game
You can now zoom in using Q and E on your keyboard
Hover zoom is now faster and with a shorter delay
Zoom sensitivity slider's factor much increased
Rulebook can now be found in the Extras menu
Fixed Vindicator not triggering properly on clients
Fixed an issue trying to join a new network game after another ended
Improved the order of death effects triggering, this fixed a few situations and raised consistency in others
Fixed wave 1 troops' ability triggering when trying to acquire them
Fixed an issue where music volume would be lost after a track faded out
Other minor fixes

Version 1.8.1

Fixes:
Fixed an issue with Vindicator Armor hanging the game
Fixed an issue where used cards might linger forever in the "casting card" slot
Fixed an issue with Smartlink Armor allowing illegal equip actions.
Fixed an issue where Bishop would only get buffed once per round
Fixed an issue where equipment would lose Weapons/Armor Divisions Wave 3 buffs
Overseer will now always spawn Gatherers when appropriate, even if the Hive deck has none

notes.title: Version 1.7.3 is out!
notes.content:
Hello, NorTec Commanders!

We've just released another update to your command interface, which will hopefully alleviate a few more issues you've encountered during your operations. 

Remember you may contact NorTec administration at xeno_app@cmon.com if you run into any problems or require our support. 

Here are the patch notes: 

You can now adjust mouse wheel zooming sensitivity
You can now zoom in Division cards properly when targeting a Division or discard pile
Fixed an issue with Eater of Hope locking up multiplayer games
Fixed an issue with Templar Armor buff being applied twice
Fixed issues with Heroic troop swapping
Fixed an issue where Necro-Stinger would trigger a chain reaction and wipe your troops
Fixed camera not showing all 4 lanes properly in 4-division games
Fixed an issue with Nano Surge Injection
Upgrading two heroes in a row should no longer trigger a visual glitch


May your mining operations always be successful!

notes.title: Version 1.7.2 is out!
notes.content:
Hello NorTec Commanders!

We've just released an emergency update to your command interface, which will hopefully alleviate some issues you've encountered during your operations.

Remember you may contact NorTec administration at xeno_app@cmon.com if you run into any more problems or require our support.

Here are the patch notes:

Fixed a few issues that might stop a game phase from ending
You can no longer start an ability while having another targeting ability up
Card playing now runs on the server and may be cancelled if invalid (This fixes issues with network latency)
Zooming and dragging a card very quickly should no longer trigger an exception
Fixed an issue with the Experimental Drop Ship


Happy mining, commanders!
